rationale: The resolution of C-44 cites VOE version 1; version 2 is current and materially different. Clearance would rely on superseded evidence.
resume_condition: Re-verify against VOE v2 and resolve the condition on current evidence.
no_single_culprit_justification: The resolution was valid when recorded; the v2 upload was a legitimate world event; the clearance proposal is well-formed. Only the composition - clearing on a resolution that predates newer required evidence - is wrong.
